method: Independent feasibility judging of all 304 wave-3 G+H+J ideas, re-read from the raw generator shards (never from any judge's accepted list). Each idea tiered on the cost of its DECISIVE falsification: T1 = frozen public models / inference / probes / analysis on public data (hours-to-days on one GPU); T2 = small trainings, short fine-tunes, CIFAR-scale diffusion trainings, small human studies, light data collection (single GPU, GPU-days, modest labor); T3 = gated data/hardware/orgs or pretraining-scale compute. feasibility_score: 5 = decisive kill in <= 1 day on a single GPU with public assets; 4 = T1-class but 1-3 days or nontrivial assembly; 3 = T2 (single-GPU training days / small human pilots); 2 = heavy T2 (multi-run grids, collection/annotation labor, scale-gapped pilots); 1 = gated. Cheap-kill quality additionally judged on: numeric kill threshold present in the prediction (GATE-1), explicit time/cost bound (GATE-3), named public dataset AND model (GATE-4), public-data + single-GPU vs needs_special_resources. Duplicate structure assessed independently; family membership treated as a merge trigger per commissioning rule C-A1; canonical master consulted only for cross-wave collision notes.
epistemic_status: NO novelty verified for any idea. Every prior-art / known-result remark (including the single kill) is this judge's unverified hypothesis. No citations asserted or invented.
